# Demo

> Records a short, paced video of the feature the user asks for in a Gradatim project's UI, or of the whole UI, with the project's own Playwright, and keeps its script beside the video. Use when the user asks for Gradatim's demo step, or to record, film or show a demo or a walkthrough of the app.

| | |
|---|---|
| Skill | `record-demo`, [its file](../../skills/record-demo/SKILL.md) |
| Step | 14 of 14: demo |
| Runs | Any time the project has a UI |
| Next | the step the user was on |
| Call it | `/gradatim:record-demo` on Claude Code; [the other hosts](install.md#calling-a-skill) |

## When to use it

- The user asks for Gradatim's demo step, or to record, film or show a demo or a walkthrough of the app. Draft PR starts it for a change a user sees.
- Not for checking that a page works: that is the project's tests, in [`build-task`](build-task.md) or [`close-task`](close-task.md). Not for a review of the UI: that is [`review-project`](review-project.md). Not for a folder with no Gradatim project: that is [`init-project`](init-project.md).

## What it reads and writes

| Document | Path | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Agent file | `AGENTS.md` | reads |
| Agent docs | `docs/agents/<topic>.md` | reads |
| MVP | `docs/MVP.md` | reads |
| Phase | `docs/PHASE-<k>.md` | reads |
| Sprint README | `docs/sprints/sprint-<n>/README.md` | reads |
| Task file | `docs/sprints/sprint-<n>/<ID>-<slug>.md` | reads |
| Demo walkthrough | `docs/demos/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.mjs` | reads, creates |
| Demo | `docs/demos/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.webm` | creates |

Of the project's own files, it changes only `.gitignore`, with the line `docs/demos/*.webm`, where git doesn't ignore the videos yet. It serves the app only through its script, installs nothing, writes no `CLAUDE.md`, runs no sync, and changes nothing sealed: a later run records a new pair.

<!-- end of the generated block -->

## Good to know

- **It needs the project's own Playwright,** 1.64 or later, and installs nothing. Where Playwright isn't ready, it gives the commands to set it up, or numbered steps for your own screen recorder.
- **Each beat opens with a card:** a title, and one line on what the viewer sees, with no caption bar.
- **The video stays on your machine, out of git:** drag it into a pull request's description on GitHub, where it plays, up to 10 MB on a free plan. The walkthrough beside it is committed.
- **After a change of the UI,** a later demo records a new dated pair, and the old pair stays as it is.
